summary: Jaleter Stripe-Premium REMOVAL — end-to-end regression PASSES on both backend and frontend. BACKEND (16/16 pytest tests pass in test_iteration88_iap_only.py): (1) Fresh user membership=inactive, /plaid/link-token, /accounts/all, /accounts/transactions all 402. (2) POST /payments/checkout jaleter_premium → 410 with 'App Store'/'Google Play' message; GET /payments/products only lists coaching_session ($75), no jaleter_premium. (3) All four removed Stripe Premium routes return 404: /payments/webhook, /payments/billing-portal, /payments/cancel-at-period-end, /payments/resume. (4) POST /iap/sync {active:true, expires_at:+1y, platform:'ios'} → {ok:true, active:true}; membership → active, source=iap, billing_platform=ios, cancel_at_period_end=false; /plaid/link-token=200 and /accounts/all=200. (5) HARDENING confirmed: iap/sync {active:false} does NOT revoke; 3y expiry is capped ≤400 days; earlier expires_at DOES NOT shorten (monotonic). (6) Legacy Stripe grandfather via direct Mongo insert: subscription_status='active' + subscription_current_period_end=now+200d → active:true, source='legacy_stripe', cancel_at_period_end=true, /accounts/all=200; past period_end → active:false + /accounts/all=402; active status but NO period_end → active:false. (7) App Review (Jaleter.appreview@gmail.com) and admin (support@jaleter.com) both membership active; App Review source='admin'. (8) Coaching flow untouched: /payments/checkout coaching_session returns url+session_id+booking_id, /payments/status/{sid} returns product=coaching_session, /coaching/bookings contains the pending booking. (9) /api/health=200; backend logs show no stripe_service import errors on this boot (only historical entries from previous supervisord starts). FRONTEND (web preview 390x844, all scenarios PASS): (10) /membership route renders Signup; after Create account → 'Your account is ready' screen with testIDs membership-subscribe-in-app, membership-store-ios, membership-store-android, membership-refresh, membership-signout all present; body has '$89.99/year', 'App Store or Google Play', 'Get Jaleter for iPhone', 'Get Jaleter for Android'; NO Stripe / 'Pay on Jaleter.com'. Then activated user via /api/iap/sync from browser fetch → tapped membership-refresh → membership-success screen 'You're all set — Your Jaleter Premium membership is active' rendered. (11) Main app /: register + onboarding Continue → hard paywall with all testIDs paywall-iap-buy, paywall-iap-restore, paywall-refresh, paywall-signout, paywall-signed-in-as; 'Signed in as ...', 'Not you? Sign out', Terms, Privacy, 'Already subscribed? Refresh membership' all visible; disclosure mentions App Store; NO 'Pay on Jaleter.com', NO Stripe, NO 'Payment processing'. Price on paywall shows $79.99/year (RC Test Store placeholder — documented in context note, NOT a bug). 'Unlock Your Full Potential' visible in screenshot. (12) Test Store E2E: paywall-iap-buy → paywall-iap-confirm shown → paywall-iap-confirm-yes → RC Test Store dialog 'Test valid purchase' clicked → dashboard unlocked (home-profile visible, no paywall-iap-buy). Then More → Membership row: ACTIVE · renews Oct 1, 2027 pill, big $89.99 / year card, 'Manage in App Store settings' (membership-manage-store) VISIBLE; NO membership-manage, NO membership-cancel, NO membership-subscribe; NO 'Manage subscription' / 'Cancel at period end' / Stripe text. Settings → Billing card shows testID billing-notice-billing = 'Manage Premium in App Store — Renewals, receipts and cancellation are handled by App Store.' (13) paywall-iap-restore on a fresh account → notice shows 'No previous App Store purchases were found for this account.' and stays on paywall (paywall-iap-buy still visible). (14) All six bottom tabs render for unlocked user (Home/Budget/Reports/Activity/Wealth/Legacy); More screen lists 'Book Coaching · Schedule + pay at jaleter.com' row.

issues: Store disclosure text mentions only 'App Store' on web preview (Platform.OS==='web' picks the Apple-side wording). Task item 11 asks the disclosure to mention 'App Store/Google Play'. On real iOS/Android builds the correct platform string is picked, so this is a web-preview artefact only — non-blocking for App Store submission. Same footnote applies to the MembershipScreen store footer, as noted in iter_87.

action_items: No code changes required — Stripe Premium removal is complete and correct on both backend and frontend. Ready for App Store resubmission.

Optional polish (also flagged in iter_87): derive the App-Store vs Google-Play wording from the IAP payload's `platform` field instead of Platform.OS in both PaywallScreen and MembershipScreen so cross-store users see the right label on the /membership web page. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:1862 — the checkout 410 branch uses PREMIUM_STORE_ONLY_MESSAGE (contains both 'App Store' and 'Google Play'); message is properly returned in FastAPI detail. Good.

backend/server.py:1965 iap_sync — expiry capping with `min(exp, now + 400d)` and monotonic `max(exp, prev)` correctly implements the client-hostile hardening spec. Inactive snapshots only bump iap_synced_at — perfect.

backend/entitlement_service.py:44 has_legacy_stripe_membership — correctly gates on both `subscription_status in _LEGACY_STRIPE_STATES` AND a future `subscription_current_period_end`. Users with status='active' but no period end are treated as inactive, matching item 6 requirement.

frontend PaywallScreen.tsx:237 — big price card fallback '$90' vs Subscribe button fallback '$90.00' (from iapPrice) still diverge; low-priority (RC always loads offering in preview). Same note as iter_87.
seed_data_creation: Multiple throwaway users created via POST /api/auth/register (test_i88_*@example.com) for each test class + membership scenario; 3 legacy-Stripe users had subscription_status/subscription_current_period_end injected into MongoDB via motor for grandfathering tests. Test users are prefixed 'test_i88_' but were NOT explicitly deleted at end of run — recommend a housekeeping cleanup query on { email: { $regex: '^test_i88_' } } if desired.
